describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, pangolin-like animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, standing on all four limbs with its body arched and its long tail extended horizontally behind it. Most of its dorsal and lateral surfaces, the top of its elongated snout, its limbs, and its tail are covered in overlapping, dark brown to grayish, keeled scales with lighter edges. Large, irregular patches of pale pink, wrinkled, fleshy skin are exposed where scales are missing on the mid-back, the mid-flank, and the lower rear flank. The head is elongated into a tapered snout with a dark nostril at the tip and fine whiskers, a small dark round eye on the side, and a small rounded ear behind the eye. The limbs are short and thick, ending in broad feet with long, curved, dark claws, and the tail is thick at the base and tapers to a point.

describe.description: The creature is a heavily built four-legged animal shown in right profile with a rounded arched body, a small elongated head tapering to a blunt pointed snout, and a long tapering tail trailing behind. Most of its upper body, top of the head, outer legs and tail are covered in overlapping dark gray-brown scales, while large irregular areas on the back, flank and rump show pale pink bare skin where scales are absent, and the underside and lower legs show pale gray-tan skin. It has a small dark eye, a rounded external ear, short sturdy legs ending in large long curved dark claws, and stands facing right on a plain light background.
